```yaml
name: Pre-release CLI Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/prerelease-cli.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/prerelease-cli.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test Pre-release CLI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096
      NPM_CONFIG_FUND: false
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Cache node_modules
        id: cache-modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: modules-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.cache-modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Cache turbo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .turbo
          key: turbo-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: turbo-

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Run TypeScript compilation
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Run linting
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Validate package structure
        run: |
          # Check that all expected packages are built
          for pkg in packages/*/; do
            if [ ! -d "$pkg/dist" ]; then
              echo "Missing dist directory in $pkg"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          # Verify main package exports
          if [ ! -f "dist/src/index.js" ] || [ ! -f "dist/src/index.d.ts" ]; then
            echo "Main package build artifacts missing"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Package validation passed"

      - name: Test CLI functionality
        run: |
          # Test that CLI can be linked and executed
          npm link
          agent-relay --version

          # Test basic CLI commands
          agent-relay help
          agent-relay doctor

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          # Run daemon-related tests specifically
          npx vitest run \
            src/daemon/**/*test.ts \
            packages/daemon/**/*test.ts \
            --reporter=verbose

      - name: Verify batched poll implementation
        run: |
          # Check that new batched poll endpoint is used
          echo "Verifying batched poll implementation..."
          
          # Look for usage of new endpoint in source files
          if grep -r "POST /api/daemons/poll" src/; then
            echo "✓ Found usage of new batched poll endpoint"
          else
            echo "✗ New batched poll endpoint not found in source"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that legacy endpoint is still present for fallback
          if grep -r "sendHeartbeatLegacy" src/; then
            echo "✓ Legacy heartbeat method found for backward compatibility"
          else
            echo "✗ Legacy heartbeat method not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify that getSyncMessagesPayload function exists
          if grep -r "getSyncMessagesPayload" src/; then
            echo "✓ Sync messages payload preparation function found"
          else
            echo "✗ Sync messages payload preparation function not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Batched poll implementation verification passed"
```
